image_description: A modern indoor staircase featuring a prominent, glossy red handrail system. The handrail is thick and tubular, supported by thin black vertical balusters. The stairs are white with a clean, minimalist design. In the background, another flight of stairs with similar railing is visible. A sign with text 'NORTEL NETWORKS' is mounted on the wall to the left.
